sections.heading: Flat Roof Repair FAQs for Bloomfield Homeowners

faqs.q: What flat-roof membrane works best on a Bloomfield two-family or garden apartment?

runs.v: A low-slope single-ply membrane suits them: white TPO reflects solar radiation and reduces cooling load on a sun-exposed flat section, while EPDM provides single-ply durability. A Newark Quality Roofing specification matches the membrane to the building use and the drainage.

faqs.q: Why does the flat roof on my Bloomfield building keep leaking?

runs.v: For a homeowner or property manager, a recurring flat-roof leak traces to a failed membrane seam, a cracked rooftop-equipment or vent penetration, or ponding water that breaks down the seam adhesive, and a low-slope roof concentrates water at a single defect. A Newark Quality Roofing repair maps the standing water, reseals the failed seam, and corrects the drainage path.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit for flat-roof work in Bloomfield, NJ?

runs.v: In New Jersey, repairing or replacing the roof covering on a detached one- or two-family home counts as ordinary maintenance under N.J.A.C. 5:23-2.7 and needs no construction permit, per the NJ Uniform Construction Code. Commercial, multi-family, and attached buildings need a permit once repairs exceed 25% of the roof area in 12 months, so flat roof replacements may require local permits; confirm with the Bloomfield construction office.

faqs.q: What is the 25% rule for roofing?

runs.v: It is a rule of thumb that a roof with more than about a quarter of its area damaged is usually better replaced than patched; in New Jersey code terms, it is also the 25%-in-12-months permit threshold for buildings other than detached one- and two-family homes.

faqs.q: Does a flat roof in a Bloomfield historic district need extra approval?

runs.v: It can, so confirm the property's status with the Bloomfield construction office before work; properties in a historic district can need extra review. Per the National Park Service, National Register listing alone places no federal restriction on a private property owner.

faqs.q: How long does a flat roof last on a Bloomfield commercial building?

runs.v: EPDM lasts 15 to 25 years, TPO 7 to 20 years, modified bitumen 20 years, and built-up roofing 30 years, per the InterNACHI life-expectancy chart, assuming the drainage clears within 48 hours, per the NRCA and ARMA; regular maintenance and inspections are crucial to extending the lifespan of flat roofs.
